## Summary

Describe the messaging concept, example, or documentation change.

## Reviewer Focus

- [ ] Failure mode or reliability concern is clear.
- [ ] Retry, DLQ, idempotency, or observability impact is explained when relevant.
- [ ] Producer and consumer responsibilities remain understandable.

## Validation

- [ ] Example or documentation is small enough to review.
- [ ] Local setup impact is documented when needed.
- [ ] Tests or scenarios explain expected message behavior.

## Portfolio Signal

Explain what this PR makes stronger for a technical interview.
